title: Smithing Progression
description: Reworks vanilla tool crafting, other recipes and progression.
body:
Have you ever felt like the smithing table is underused? 
Have you ever felt that some tiers of tools are worthless or too easy to get?
Do I have the pack for you, introducing "Smithing Progression" a rework of vanilla tool progression with new recipes and advancements!

Pack is still a work in progress, releasing it to receive feedback and ideas for more recipes and changes.
Use advancements for hints.
